rules.title: Motion to study and report on feasibility of banning algorithm-based rent-setting software
rules.quote: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on the use of this software to set rents in the City.
rules.summary: The City Council moves to direct the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on entities using algorithmic rent-setting software and the feasibility of banning such software in the City.
